steps.npc: My name is Goat Poo. But human not allowed to make big deal of it, 'cos it mean to tease people 'bout silly name.

options.text: Why are you called Goat Poo?

steps.player: Why are you called Goat Poo?

steps.npc: Look, trolls are named after first thing they try to eat, when they little kids. That is troll tradition.

steps.player: So the first thing you ate was goat poo?

steps.npc: It my parents' fault - they should have been paying proper attention an' stopped me. But no, they just named me after it.
Still, it coulda been worse. Could have been called Yellow Snow. He got a really dumb name.

options.text: Okay, I won't ask why you're called Goat Poo.

steps.player: Okay, I won't ask why you're called Goat Poo.

steps.npc: Most people do eventually. Over an' over again.
This here is Weiss. Trolls built it years ago, after we got kicked out from caves further south. Now Weiss is our home.
We done pretty good here. Got lots of goat and wolf to eat - they taste kinda boring after all this time, but there not much other choice.

steps.player: Ever tried goutweed? I know trolls who love it. In fact My Arm is an expert on growing the stuff.

steps.npc: Never heard of no gouty weed, no. But it sound like a vegetable, an' Mother not like eating those, so we probably not gonna try it.
Mother not like new ideas much, but he really big, an' he boss, so we do what he say.
Eh, it kinda rough, but it our home. Odd Mushroom say he can make it nicer with fancy fires what he invented, but Mother not interested in that, so Odd Mushroom not allowed to do it.
Mother only care about stuff to help him fight better. An he really big, an' he boss, so we do what he say.

when-using-ugthanki-dung-on-goat-poo.npc: You t'ink I want that? It not even from goat!

when-using-goat-dung-on-goat-poo.npc: Look, human, it were one time. Just once. Let a troll move on, okay?

when-using-a-bucket-on-goat-poo.npc: Look, human, this not funny. You need goat poo in bucket, go find goat pen!
